# prague-bible-1488 fixtures

Three page files copied VERBATIM (whole, untrimmed) from the `page/`
directory of the Zenodo record 14524858 zip
(DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14524858, v1.0, "HTR Winter School 2024 - Medieval
Czech - Prague Bible (1488)"), retrieved 2026-10-10 from
https://zenodo.org/api/records/14524858/files/Bible_prazska_1488-20241219T111644Z-001.zip/content
(36,365,040 bytes, md5 f4b09d8c45472f94ee79bff122bc7852 — the record's
own checksum — sha256
00b6c86a33c475fcc3598c8ca27089be8743a965fd877f0ba50a2619285377a1).

License: CC BY 4.0 on the record (the deposited htr-united yml agrees;
the deposited CITATION.cff says CC-BY-SA-4.0). Either way the files may
be redistributed with attribution: Michalcová, Plechatý, Katscher,
Hedvíková, Škvrňák, Spěváčková, Švarc, Hejdová, Steiner.

- `page/0023_DTL_547662-0024.xml` — Genesis (segment 1): two text
  columns (regions `tr_1`, `r`), the running title "Prwnie knihy" as the
  first line of the first column, abbreviation tags.
- `page/0217_DTL_547662-0218.xml` — Joshua: both regions typed
  `structure {type:paragraph;}`, abbrev + superscript (textStyle) +
  `unclear` spans.
- `page/0501_DTL_547662-0502.xml` — Judith: three regions, the first a
  ONE-line running-title region ("Knihy"); every region carries the
  export's empty region-level TextEquiv.

Re-cut: download the zip, copy these three files from
`Bible_prazska_1488/page/` unchanged.
